caption:
Three goals in 14 minutes. China never recovered.

India beat China 6-2 in the Women's Asian Champions Trophy on Tuesday. Deepika scored a field goal in the 1st minute and two penalty corners by the 14th. That is her second hat-trick in a row after three against Thailand. Lalremsiami, Neha Goyal and Sakshi Rana added the rest in Bhopal.

The context: China are the Paris Olympics silver medallists but RevSportz reports 13 players made their international debuts here and head coach Alyson Annan was not with the team.

India and Japan have both won all four games. India lead on goal difference (+15 to +8) and the two meet on Wednesday at 7 pm IST for top spot before the semi-finals.
